safety_security_measures_007.evidence: The safety and security of all school buildings and grounds will be carried out through notices posted on all exterior doors stating the requirement that all visitors go to the office and get, and wear, a visitor's permit; security locks on exterior doors; and a bell system in elementary schools which will permit the control of a particular door by the administrative staff.

safety_weapons_008.evidence: The possession of firearms or other dangerous weapons by students and/or staff members shall be prohibited on school system property and school sponsored events at all times and in school vehicles at all times, except as authorized by the Superintendent of Schools. ... Employees are expected to comply with the policy regarding a gun-free environment. Failure to do so will result in administrative action up to and including termination for failure to follow board policy.
